rounds.strengths: 版式清楚，八格辨识迅速；红色菌盖与奶油色糕体构成稳定系列感，统一光源和柔和投影让整张概览表完成度较高。
rounds.defects: 个别阶段的形体区分更多依赖容器和层数，红色圆顶元素重复度偏高；右下多层主体的轴线、层间接触和尺寸递进不够精确，切片侧面的奶油层也略显机械平直。
rounds.next_fix: 优先校正右下多层蛋糕的同心轴、层间承托和各层椭圆边缘，再细化切片与整糕的胚体孔隙、奶油厚薄和糖衣边缘，使阶段差异更明确且减少塑料般的平滑感。

score_evidence.composition: 八个白底卡片以四列两行等距排列，主体均居中且由左上小体量逐步过渡到右下三层大体量。
score_evidence.lighting_color: 各格主体左上侧受暖白光照亮、右下方落有柔灰阴影，红色顶面与米色糕体的明暗关系基本统一。
score_evidence.perspective_anatomy: 多数甜点同时露出顶面和正面，圆形层体保持稳定椭圆透视，但右下多层蛋糕各层的中心轴与边缘收分略有偏差。
score_evidence.texture_detail: 杯托竖褶、塔皮沟槽、蛋糕胚细颗粒和奶油波纹清晰可见，但多处红色糖衣表面较平滑单一。
score_evidence.spec_style: 八件物体均采用圆润厚边、低频细节和红白米色配色，形成一致的软质玩具化烘焙造型。
score_evidence.flawlessness: 轮廓整体干净且没有明显断裂杂点，不过右下顶层与中层连接处显得拥挤，部分奶油夹层边缘厚薄不匀。

lessons.lesson: 本轮短板偏「line_edge」：个别阶段的形体区分更多依赖容器和层数，红色圆顶元素重复度偏高；右下多层主体的轴线、层间接触和尺寸递进不够精确，切片侧面的奶油层也略显机械平直。
lessons.drill: 透明底边缘检查：放大 200% 查毛边与漏抠

reasonableness.revised_prompt:
Casual merge-game dessert bakery shop_ladder overview_sheet, aspect 4:3, 2x4 equal white rounded cards on deep charcoal, 单件居中 one soft-plastic TOY dessert centered per card, not a scene. Matte clay soft-plastic Travel Town / Merge Mansion cabinet icons, NOT photoreal food. Soft studio key, short contact shadows, saturated friendly. No text no faces no birds no gift box.

Family gene every tier: red mushroom cap + cream white dots + cream dessert language.
chain_mode=shop_ladder. commercial_ref: MiniCreamPuff→Macaron→Cupcake→CreamCup→Tart→CakeSlice→WholeCake→GrandTierCake.

merge_why / evolve_to:
L1 MiniMushroomCreamPuff — tiny cream puff ball under mushroom cap, single centered item.
L2 MushroomMacaron merge_why=two puffs → flat disc macaron sandwich, single centered.
L3 MushroomCupcake merge_why=two macarons → paper-liner cupcake, single centered.
L4 MushroomCreamCup merge_why=two cupcakes → clear short soft-plastic toy glass cream cup, single centered.
L5 MushroomCreamTart merge_why=two cups → wide flat open tart wider than cup, single centered.
L6 MushroomCakeSlice merge_why=two tarts → triangular layered cake slice, single centered.
L7 WholeMushroomCake merge_why=two slices → whole round two-layer cake, single centered.
L8 GrandTierMushroomCake merge_why=two whole cakes → THREE-TIER tall celebration mushroom cream cake, largest body, reward feast SKU, same family, single centered — NOT a gift box, NOT smaller than L7.

Silhouette jumps: ball→disc→cupcake→cup→tart→triangle→round cake→tall three-tier tower. Fail if gift box, candy bag, topping pile, L8 smaller than L7, photoreal oily food, multi-item scene.
